newsitem.title: FRANCE: French deficit below 4 pct of GDP in 1996 - Arthuis.
newsitem.headline: French deficit below 4 pct of GDP in 1996 - Arthuis.

text.p: Finance Minister Jean Arthuis said in a new conference address on Wednesday he was confident that France's public deficit would be less than four percent of gross domestic product (GDP) in 1996 and that next year would mark a turning point on public spending.
"For this year, we pledged to remain below four percent of GDP. I am very confident this target will be met despite a slower than expected recovery in welfare accounts.
"In 1997 we want to get below the three percent level. The course is set, we will do everything to hold it."

"Perhaps we do not realise it today, but economic history will consider later that it was in 1997 that France turned its back on the ballooning of public spending and that it began the reduction in taxation that was so long awaited."
